claims.text: A generalized Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling method extending Metropolis et al. (1953) is presented.
Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling methods can be used to generate random orthogonal matrices.
Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling methods can be applied to numerical problems arising in statistics.

evidence.description: A generalization of the sampling method introduced by Metropolis et al. (1953) is presented along with an exposition of the relevant theory.
Examples of the methods, including the generation of random orthogonal matrices... are discussed.
...potential applications of the methods to numerical problems arising in statistics, are discussed.

methodologies.name: Generalized Metropolis Sampling Method
methodologies.description: A generalized Monte Carlo sampling framework using Markov chains.

limitations.text: There are difficulties in assessing the error in Monte Carlo estimates.

future_work.text: Application of generalized Markov chain Monte Carlo methods to numerical problems arising in statistics.
